lacmus.save_error: Could not save. Use Retry save to try again.
lacmus.reset.title: Restore default settings?
lacmus.reset.description: This resets every Lacmus setting. Your current settings will be replaced.
lacmus.hint.toggle: Click or press Enter to toggle. Hover for details.
lacmus.hint.number: Drag the value left/right. Hold Shift to change it by 1. Keyboard: left/right arrows, with Shift by 1.
lacmus.hint.choice: Click or press Enter for the next choice. Keyboard: left/right arrows.
lacmus.setting.visible.description: Hidden, it sends no ping requests either.
lacmus.setting.mode.description: Easy to read: one line with fps, latency and jitter. Full: every metric.
lacmus.setting.latency.description: rtt: the newest round trip. ping: the mean round trip of the last 5 seconds.
lacmus.setting.anchor.description: The screen corner the HUD sits in.
lacmus.setting.scale.description: Text size, in percent of the interface scale.
lacmus.setting.panel_opacity.description: Opacity of the panel behind the text.
lacmus.setting.show_frame_max.descriptio: Next to fps: the longest frame of the last second.
lacmus.setting.show_client_tick.descript: How long the client's tick takes on average.
lacmus.setting.show_queue.description: How long packets wait for the game to handle them.
lacmus.setting.show_jitter.description: How much one round trip differs from the previous one.
lacmus.setting.show_bytes.description: Bytes per second in and out.
lacmus.setting.show_packets.description: Packets per second in and out.
lacmus.setting.show_server.description: The estimated tick rate of the server.
lacmus.setting.alarms.description: A line that reports a problem on its side turns red.
lacmus.setting.queue_alarm.description: The client line turns red when packets wait this long.
lacmus.setting.client_tick_alarm.descrip: The client line turns red when its tick takes this long on average.
lacmus.setting.tps_alarm.description: The server line turns red below this share of the server's target tick rate.
lacmus.setting.ping_requests.description: Send the game's own ping requests on a server while the HUD is shown. Off: latency only while the F3 network chart is open.
lacmus.setting.pings_per_second.descript: More requests show a change sooner; each is a few bytes.
